# Is this motor club dispatch worth the truck-hour?

> Free calculator for independent tow and roadside operators: is this Agero, Urgent.ly, Honk or AAA-contractor dispatch worth taking? Cost of the job, profit per truck-hour, break-even payout, minimum payout, accept or decline, and a batch ranking of calls. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
